1. Science. 1983 Feb 25;219(4587):979-80. doi: 10.1126/science.6823561.

Chronic Parkinsonism in humans due to a product of meperidine-analog synthesis.

Langston JW, Ballard P, Tetrud JW, Irwin I.

Four persons developed marked parkinsonism after using an illicit drug 
intravenously. Analysis of the substance injected by two of these patients 
revealed primarily 1-methyl-4-phenyl-1,2,5,6-tetrahydropyridine (MPTP) with 
trace amounts of 1-methyl-4-phenyl-4-propionoxy-piperidine (MPPP). On the basis 
of the striking parkinsonian features observed in our patients, and additional 
pathological data from one previously reported case, it is proposed that this 
chemical selectively damages cells in the substantia nigra.
